mlm:name: SatVision-TOA
description: SatVision-TOA is a 3 billion parameter vision transformer-based geospatial foundation model pre-trained on 100 million MODIS L1B Top-Of-Atmosphere (TOA) radiance images across 14 spectral bands. It is designed for moderate- and coarse-resolution all-sky remote sensing imagery, excelling in tasks such as 3D cloud retrieval and image reconstruction, and demonstrates strong transferability to other sensors.
masking_strategy: Randomly mask 8x8 patches (60% masking ratio) of input image chips
pretraining: Self-supervised learning using Masked-Image-Modeling on 100 million MODIS TOA image chips (128x128x14), with SwinV2 Giant architecture, trained for 50 epochs using AdamW optimizer and bfloat16 precision.
mlm:pretrained_source: MODIS L1B Top-Of-Atmosphere (TOA) global daily composites
regions_coverage: Global (all continents and oceans, NW, NE, SW, SE quadrants)
sampling: Stratified sampling across global quadrants and cover types using clustering on land- and cloud-cover structure; Time range: March 2000 to present (10 years, ~270 days/year)
processing:lineage: Elliptical Weighted Averaging (EWA) for band aggregation; Min-max scaling for brightness temperature; Scaling reflectance by 0.01; Selection of lowest view zenith angle; Solar zenith angle < 72 deg
cloud_cover: All-sky (no cloud filtering, includes cloudy and clear-sky)
missing_data: Overlapping observations: select lowest view zenith angle; only daytime images used

mlm:hyperparameters.learning_rate: max 0.00159727 (OneCycle cosine scheduler, linear warmup, AdamW optimizer)

benchmarks.spatial_resolution: variable (ABI native, matched to MODIS 1 km)
